claims.head: Point-blank against perimeter
claims.body: On shot quality, Montréal sits 1st of 32, at the point-blank end of the scale. Nashville is 23rd, at the perimeter end.

MTL.head: Montréal should have the upper hand
MTL.body: Montréal has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Nashville’s way back in is a power play that gets going.

NSH.head: A tough matchup for Nashville
NSH.body: Montréal has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Nashville’s best way through is a power play that gets going.
